The authors introduce a new dataset, PubTables-1M, to benchmark progress in table extraction from unstructured documents, as well as table structure recognition and functional analysis. sources.snippet: A: This model detects table locations and returns bounding boxes; the table-transformer-structure-recognition model parses cell boundaries and structure within detected tables. Use both in sequence: detection first to localize tables, then structure recognition on cropped table regions. Q: What image resolutions does this model handle?
